title: Portals
intro: Send your listings to property portals. Each connection has a rule that picks the listings it sends: all of your PUBLIC listings, the ones carrying a tag, or only the ones you choose. Only active listings published as PUBLIC are ever sent.
choicesCount: {include, plural, =0 {} other {# always sent}}{include, plural, =0 {} other { · }}{exclude, plural, =0 {none held back} other {# held back}}

rule.title: Which listings
rule.hint: You can still include or hold back single listings below.
rule.tagHint: Only for “tagged listings”: the exact tag, in lower case.

add.title: Connect a portal
add.name: Name
add.credentialsHint: One per line as name=value, using the names the portal asks for. Stored encrypted and never shown again.

issued.title: Feed token
issued.intro: Copy this token now: it is shown only once. The portal's feed address, which uses it, appears here when feeds are switched on for your account.

token.title: Feed token
token.intro: The portal fetches your feed with this token. Making a new one stops the old one working at once.
token.active: Active token ending in {hint}, made on {date}.
token.revoked: The feed is turned off until you make a new token.
token.turnOn: Turn the feed on with a new token

choices.title: Single listings
choices.intro: Always send a listing the rule would skip, or hold one back. A listing that is not active and PUBLIC is never sent, whatever you choose.
choices.refsHint: One reference per line, or separated by spaces or commas (at most 200).

preview.title: Sent now
preview.intro: The first listings this connection sends, by reference.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Only agency admins can change portal connections.
errors.PORTAL_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE: That portal can not be connected yet.
errors.PORTAL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED: Your agency has as many portal connections as allowed.
errors.PORTAL_CONNECTION_NAME_TAKEN: You already have a connection to this portal with that name.
errors.PORTAL_OVERRIDE_LIMIT_REACHED: This connection has as many single-listing choices as allowed.
errors.LISTING_NOT_FOUND: One or more references match none of your listings. Nothing was changed.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the details and try again.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this connection. Reload and try again.

issues.title: Listings left out of the feed
issues.summary: Last check {date}: {valid, plural, one {# listing} other {# listings}} sent, {invalid, plural, =0 {none left out} one {# left out} other {# left out}}.
issues.never: No feed has been checked yet. The first check runs when the feed is generated.

codes.NO_DOCUMENT: The listing has no published page content yet; it is refreshed automatically.
codes.PRICE_ON_REQUEST: This portal does not take a price on request; add a price.
codes.PRICE_PERIOD: This portal takes sale prices and monthly or weekly rents only.
codes.TOWN_MISSING: Add a town or area (the location is too general).
codes.ENERGY_RATING_MISSING: Add the energy rating (CEE), or mark it exempt or in progress.
codes.PHOTOS_TOO_FEW: Add photos: {actual} of the {min} this portal needs.
codes.DESCRIPTION_TOO_SHORT: The description has {actual} characters; this portal needs at least {min}.
codes.DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG: The description has {actual} characters; this portal takes at most {max}.

runs.title: Feed runs
runs.intro: The feed is regenerated when your listings or this connection change, and every night. A run whose content did not change leaves the file as it is.
runs.file: Feed file {file}: {count, plural, one {# listing} other {# listings}}, {size}, last changed {date}.
runs.noFile: No feed file yet. It is generated within minutes of the connection being set up.

reasons.TOO_LARGE: The feed is larger than the 64 MB limit.
reasons.GENERATION_FAILED: The feed could not be generated; it is retried automatically.
reasons.WRITER_DROPPED: A listing that passed the checks could not be written; the feed was not changed. Support has been told.
reasons.SUPERSEDED: Another run of this feed finished first; its file is the one served.
reasons.revoked: The feed URL is turned off.
reasons.writer-disabled: This portal is not available yet.
reasons.no-profile: This portal is not available yet.
reasons.not-verified: Your agency is not verified, so no listing can be published.
reasons.no-locales: Your agency has no content language.
